article.title: Effects of curcumin on depression, anxiety, and stress symptoms in adults: a GRADE-assessed systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis.
article.authors: Alsanie SA, Alblaji M, Alharbi NA
article.abstract: This systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis aimed to quantitatively assess the effects of curcumin supplementation on depression, anxiety, and stress in adults.
